STI- Maam teaches really well, her classes are enough to understand all the concepts. Exam e questions easy e thake, but u have to be quick. She provides also very detailed slides
Kmm- Sir is super cool. He covers all the basics concepts and gives questions from slides and class practice problems. There will be a short project which carries 10/15% marks
